title: Synthetic Profile Curator — continuous batch recommendation reconciler
creator: Priya Kapoor
description: Build a continuous recommendation reconciler that synthesizes short-term profiler snapshots and long-term synthetic workload signatures to produce safe batching and KV-cache parameter suggestions. The reconciler should: 1) merge telemetry signals (latency p95, token throughput, cold-start rate), 2) apply heuristic guards (min-reqs per microbatch, kv-hit safety), 3) rank candidate configs by expected cost delta and risk, and 4) feed a staged apply pipeline (shadow -> canary -> phased) with automated rollback triggers.
acceptance_criteria: Reconcilers produce deterministic ranked config suggestions for 90% of profiled workloads
Suggested configs include batching.window_ms, max_microbatch_size, kv_prefix_cache_ttl, and expected cost delta estimate
Controller supports shadow apply mode recording live metrics without changing serving configs
Canary apply supports % based traffic shifts and automated rollback on SLO regressions
End-to-end integration tests exercising a simulated microburst workload and a cold-start heavy workload pass in CI
technical_notes: Profiler inputs: rolling 5m histograms for seq_len, tokens/request, arrival delta quantiles; store compact signatures (Bloom-filter-like) to speed comparisons
Heuristics: require >= 2000 requests/day for candidate changes unless cost savings > 20% and risk=low
Cost model: combine per-token runtime estimate, expected cache hit improvement, and batching latency penalty to compute expected unit-cost delta
Safety: isolate suggestions by model family + instance type (same quantization/seq profile); avoid cross-model blending
Telemetry tags: include route_id, model_version, customer_tier to enable rollback scoping
rollout_plan: 1) Shadow apply for 48h on staging; collect metric deltas and validate cost model predictions
2) Canary: 5% traffic for 2h, 25% for next 6h with automated SLO checks (latency p95 < baseline + 20ms, error rate < baseline * 1.5)
3) Phased ramp to 100% over 24h if no triggers; otherwise, auto-rollback to previous config and create incident note
4) Post-rollout: run 7d regression job comparing predicted vs actual cost savings and capture a deviation score
testing_plan: Unit tests for signature synthesizer and heuristic rule-set
Load tests in perf lab using mixed seq-length traces derived from production anonymized profiles
Integration: end-to-end shadow dataset run that asserts no customer-facing changes
Chaos: inject high microburst patterns and ensure rollback triggers within 10 minutes
